purpose: Six portfolio artworks matching the existing Frazko Apps Lab campaign images

artworks.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished landscape 16:9 portfolio artwork for Frazko Apps Lab, a direct visual continuation of the supplied existing app campaign images. Those input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY; do not modify or collage them.
Art direction: near-black cinematic background, refined softly rounded hairline border around the composition, extremely polished realistic 3D floating app UI panels, tactile glossy glass, restrained colored edge glow, rich photographic vignettes relevant to the app, subtle depth and perspective, sophisticated premium software launch campaign. Match the references' visual density, lighting, contrast and serious product illustration feel. Not flat vector art, not a generic icon on a gradient.
Layout: reserve the left 28% for a beautiful legible product name and a compact arrangement of 3 recognizable feature icons. Main dimensional interface scene fills the right 72%, with a small overlapping supporting panel near the bottom. Keep all important elements, full product name and outer border safely inside 6% margins. Deliver exactly one seamless wide image, no collage of apps, no second panel peeking at the edges, no footer slogan. Text: only the exact product name supplied below; other UI is represented with photos, icons, tiny neutral non-letter marks, charts and numbers, no slogans, paragraphs or gibberish. This is conceptual campaign artwork, not a literal app screenshot. No App Store badge, no invented adoption numbers, no certification, no watermark.

Product: SeeYa, social planning with private friend circles, places, availability and shared memories. Palette: deep violet, coral #ff796d and soft white. Main scene: floating dark-violet mobile panels showing a small circle of diverse adult friends, an inviting photo of a casual outdoor meetup at golden hour, an availability calendar with colored dots and a place pin, small overlapping coral RSVP panel with 3 avatar portraits and checkmark icons. Left icons: friends circle, calendar, location pin. Product name exactly "SeeYa" in friendly elegant white lettering with a coral accent. Youthful premium and warm; the photographic people are normal friends, not glamour models.

Product: Mesh Lab, nearby phone-to-phone exchange of messages, location and voice notes without an internet connection. Palette: electric cyan and ice-blue, restrained emerald signals, midnight navy. Scene: three realistic slim smartphones angled in a dark topographic landscape, each displaying distinct simple chat bubble icons, location pins or voice waveform; fine luminous cyan links connect the three devices through small node points, with subtle local radio ripples. A small glass diagnostic panel with connection bars overlays foreground, and a terrain map is faintly visible underneath. No satellite, no globe, no Internet cloud, no claim of unlimited range. Left icons: connected nodes, location pin, voice waveform. Exact product name "Mesh Lab" in precise clean white typography. Cinematic field technology like the Aquiando and Convoy references.
